place: Diglipur Saddle Peak and Twin Islands
text:
Saddle Peak National Park is a national park in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in India. It was set up in 1979 on the surrounding areas of Saddle Peak. Saddle Peak or Saddle Hills 
is located on North Andaman Island.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Diglipur is a friendly, dusty little town in the North and Middle Andaman district of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in India.  The main attractions do not lie within the town itself, but this is where buses arrive and depart from.  Tourist accommodation is located in the nearby village of Kalipur.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
